ITEM 1 | Main mound of food in the center of a white square plate, roughly 10 cm by 9 cm footprint covering about 40% of the plate; irregular clumped pieces stacked 2-3 cm high; orange-red tomato-colored coating with darker red-brown patches and pale cream/yellowish interior visible in gaps; moist and slightly glossy with a saucy sheen; soft, clumped and holding shape loosely; small green flecks scattered throughout; sits directly on the plate surface | 210

ITEM 2 | Small detached crumb-like piece of the same orange-red and cream material at the left edge of the mound, about 2 cm across, irregular and flattened, lying on the plate | 12

ITEM 3 | Tiny fragment of the same orange-red and cream material near the lower left of the mound, about 1 cm across, irregular and crumbly, lying on the plate | 5

ITEM 4 | Thin smear of orange-red sauce visible as a moist film on the white plate around the base of the mound, sparse and only a few millimeters thick | 8
